patches.before: Nakasaad sa materyal para sa Antas 2 na inililipat ang punla sa pagtatanim ng sibuyas. Paliwanag ito ng paraang inililipat ang punla at pinalalaki sa bukid, at hiwalay ito sa paliwanag tungkol sa mga organong bumubuo sa nakakain na bombilya. Sa paggawa ng tala tungkol sa sibuyas, maglaan ng magkahiwalay na hanay para sa kinakain na bahagi at paraan ng pagtatanim. Huwag itong ilipat sa hanay ng tuwirang paghahasik kasama ng daikon dahil lamang may bilog itong bombilya sa ilalim ng lupa.
patches.after: Nakasaad sa materyal para sa Antas 2 na inililipat ang punla sa pagtatanim ng sibuyas. Paliwanag ito ng paraang inililipat ang punla at pinalalaki sa bukid, at hiwalay ito sa paliwanag tungkol sa mga organong bumubuo sa bilugang bahaging kinakain. Sa paggawa ng tala tungkol sa sibuyas, maglaan ng magkahiwalay na hanay para sa kinakain na bahagi at paraan ng pagtatanim. Huwag itong ilipat sa hanay ng tuwirang paghahasik kasama ng daikon dahil lamang may bilugan itong bahagi sa ilalim ng lupa.
patches.reason: Bombilya denotes a light bulb in Tagalog, not the edible onion bulb. Use the source’s neutral rounded edible part wording without adding a root/tuber classification.

patches.before: Ihambing ang dalawang dahilan ng huling pagsisimula ng bisa
patches.after: Ihambing ang dalawang dahilan ng pagkaantala ng pagsisimula ng bisa
patches.reason: Huling can mean final/last. Pagkaantala explicitly preserves delayed onset in 遅く効く rather than suggesting a final onset.

numericFindings: Independently read all 180 translated fields (12 lesson-locale pairs: 6 Khmer and 6 Tagalog), in three bounded chunks directly beside the reviewed Japanese. This includes every title, objective, activity, all 36 headings and all 36 body paragraphs in each locale; no intermediary locale was used.

Both locales preserve nitrogen-fertilizer alias identity: 硝安 and 硝酸アンモニウム identify one ammonium-nitrate fertilizer. BB/organic-blend examples retain that organic addition is common, not universal. Pellet cylinder describes form separately from mixed ingredients. Delayed organic microbial decomposition remains distinct from poorly soluble chemical constituents.

Both fertilizer p5 translations preserve some products, 1 year or more (>=1 year), and explicitly reject uniform duration guarantees. Hormone lessons preserve five substances, very small quantities, gibberellin dormancy breaking versus ABA dormancy induction only, cytokinin lateral buds/leaf ageing, and ethylene gas plus both promotion and inhibition of flowering.

Both weed lessons retain selective/non-selective target scope separately from stem/leaf uptake and soil-residual pathways. Larger weeds reduce soil-treatment efficacy. Residual equipment contamination differs from drift; terminology does not authorize a particular contemporary product or crop use.

Both vegetable lessons preserve five vegetables, three cabbage forms and their listed traits, summer cool highland cultivation, napa use/season separately from sowing dates, transplanting separately from leaf form/edible parts, and spinach year-round cultivation rather than year-round harvest from one plant. Tagalog onion light-bulb false friend is corrected by exact patch.

Facility p1 in both locales: Japanese 約56.2万t exactly converts to approximately 562,000 metric tonnes. Facility p4: 約13.5万t exactly converts to approximately 135,000 metric tonnes. Both retain 2018 and national protected-cultivation scope, explicitly excluding all-cultivation/current interpretations.

Facility p6 in both locales retains planted area decreasing while yield per 10a increases (Khmer spaced 10 a, Tagalog 10a); neither converts the denominator nor invents comparison years or rates. The largest protected-cultivation area claim is kept distinct from production weight; vegetative/reproductive growth occurs in parallel.

Facility regions match Japanese: tomato Kumamoto/Aichi/Hokkaido; strawberry Tochigi/Fukuoka/Kumamoto. These remain examples rather than current rankings. Fruit lessons retain four purposes, Unshu mikan specifically, generic pear (no added Japanese-pear restriction), before-harvest timing, many rather than all fruit trees, two monorail types, and crawler/self-propelled descriptors without granting ride permission.
